prompt: Design a wall bracket: a 60 x 30 x 5 mm plate with rounded corners, two M3 countersunk screw holes 22 mm either side of the centre, and a hollow round boss in the middle (14 mm across, rising 20 mm above the plate, 2.4 mm walls) for a dowel. Engrave 'V2' on the top. It must stay under 62 mm wide to fit the rail, so save that as a check, and make sure the boss wall is at least 2 mm thick.
